architecture.persistence: SQLite + better-sqlite3 behind a Repository Pattern (ADR-0002)

masterStateGovernanceRule.statement: A material GHARIBO decision affecting architecture, training, datasets, experiments, models, knowledge graph, procurement intelligence, integrations, security/IP or roadmap is NOT an accepted project decision until (1) governance/GHARIBO_MASTER_STATE.json is updated, (2) validation passes, (3) required ADR/doc updates are completed, and (4) the change is checkpointed in Git.

decisions.title: Next.js Route Handlers as the application backend
decisions.decision: Use Next.js App Router Route Handlers (app/api/**/route.ts) as the application backend, behind a thin controller to repository to service layering.
decisions.rationale: A single deployable full-stack app keeps the vertical slice small and typed end-to-end; file-based Route Handlers give a server-only API surface without running a separate backend process.

decisions.title: SQLite + better-sqlite3 behind a Repository Pattern
decisions.decision: Persist to SQLite via better-sqlite3, accessed only through a Repository Pattern so the storage engine can be swapped without touching controllers or UI.
decisions.rationale: SQLite is file-based and zero-ops for a single-node lab, and the repository boundary makes a later PostgreSQL swap a repository-only change (P2-04).

decisions.title: One provider abstraction with interchangeable backends
decisions.decision: Route all model access through a single ModelProvider interface with four interchangeable backends (openai-compatible, ollama, vllm, huggingface).
decisions.rationale: Provider-neutrality prevents lock-in to a single vendor and lets the Playground stream from any configured backend, configured at runtime from the database rather than hard-coded.

decisions.title: Store provider credentials by reference, never as values
decisions.decision: Store provider credentials as an env-var reference (api_key_ref); raw values live only in the local environment and are resolved at call time.
decisions.rationale: A public repository must never contain a secret; referencing credentials by name keeps the database and the repository free of credential values.

decisions.title: Training is launch-ready only in Milestone 1
decisions.decision: Milestone 1 ships training as launch-ready only: full configuration plus a real pre-flight check, with execution gated.
decisions.rationale: The lab must never claim training it has not run; gating execution keeps every metric honest and forbids fabricated results.

decisions.title: npm workspaces monorepo with a shared types package
decisions.decision: Structure the repository as an npm workspaces monorepo (apps/web, packages/shared) with a shared, type-only types package.
decisions.rationale: Native workspaces add no tooling and let the web app and the Python services share one authoritative type definition.

decisions.title: Data Factory as an explicit pipeline state machine
decisions.decision: Model data curation as an explicit state machine RAW to NORMALIZED to REVIEW_REQUIRED to APPROVED to TRAINING_READY, with REJECTED, enforced server-side.
decisions.rationale: An explicit, server-enforced state machine makes the provenance of every training record auditable and makes an illegal state jump impossible even when the API is called directly.

decisions.title: Gate model promotion through registry statuses
decisions.decision: Gate model promotion through registry statuses EXPERIMENT to CANDIDATE to ACCEPTED to DEPRECATED, enforced in the repository layer.
decisions.rationale: A model earns its version number: evaluation, not intent, is the gate, and enforcement belongs in the repository rather than only in the UI.

decisions.title: Restrict CORS on Python services to an explicit allow-list
decisions.decision: The Python FastAPI ML services allow CORS only from an explicit allow-list.
decisions.rationale: Wildcard CORS on an ML service is an avoidable exposure; an explicit allow-list is the safe default.

decisions.title: Root scripts delegate to workspaces; Next.js pinned at the repo root
decisions.decision: Root npm scripts delegate to the workspace, and Next.js is pinned at the repository root.
decisions.rationale: A single entry point per operation keeps CI and local usage identical and avoids version skew across workspaces.

decisions.title: Provider-neutral TrainingWorker abstraction with Kaggle as Worker #1
decisions.decision: Define a provider-neutral TrainingWorker interface; Kaggle is Worker #1, not the architecture.
decisions.rationale: The free-Kaggle worker must be replaceable; the interface, not the provider, is the durable contract.

decisions.title: The canonical Training Package as the portable training contract
decisions.decision: Define the canonical Training Package as the portable, reproducible training contract exported from the AI LAB.
decisions.rationale: A single content-addressed package makes a training run reproducible on any worker and decouples the lab from the training environment.

decisions.title: Content-addressed immutable dataset versions with deterministic hashed splits
decisions.decision: Version datasets by content address and produce deterministic, hashed TRAIN / VALIDATION / TEST splits.
decisions.rationale: Immutable, content-addressed versions and deterministic splits are what make an experiment re-runnable and its provenance verifiable.

decisions.title: Zero-cost artifact policy — optional private HF, local fallback, never GitHub
decisions.decision: Store model artifacts in an optional private Hugging Face repo with a complete local fallback; GitHub holds source and documentation only.
decisions.rationale: Artifacts must survive the ephemeral runtime at zero cost, and a public repository must never carry weights.

decisions.title: Zero monetary cost training policy (CEO mandate)
decisions.decision: Training must operate at zero monetary cost: free compute (Kaggle T4), free-tier storage, and a local fallback; no paid provider may become a dependency.
decisions.rationale: A binding CEO mandate: capability must not depend on a purchased GPU machine or a paid training provider.

decisions.title: Initial 800-example gold split cut at seed 3407
decisions.decision: Cut the first GHARIBO-Research-Gold-v0.1 split (640 / 80 / 80) at seed 3407.
decisions.rationale: Superseded. Its TEST split contained 10 of the 100 audited examples, so TEST was not genuinely held out, and the assignment was not reproducible from any committed source because the seed-3407 generator was never versioned. The decision was replaced by DEC-0017 (audit-aware deterministic split at seed 20260914).

decisions.title: Audit-aware deterministic gold split at seed 20260914
decisions.decision: Re-cut the split with a committed, audit-aware deterministic generator (seed 20260914) that quarantines the 100-example audit cohort into TRAIN + VALIDATION, guaranteeing audited ∩ TEST = 0.
decisions.rationale: The superseded seed-3407 TEST split was contaminated and not reproducible. A committed generator plus an audit-quarantine rule makes the split reproducible and genuinely holds TEST out.

decisions.title: Universal Commercial + Procurement Knowledge Graph as the library architecture
decisions.decision: Model the GHARIBO library as a Universal Commercial + Procurement Knowledge Graph with PRODUCTS, SERVICES and ORGANIZATIONS as first-class entities and evidence/provenance as first-class concepts.
decisions.rationale: A flat product catalog cannot express who supplies, installs, integrates and maintains a system, nor the evidence behind a commercial claim.

decisions.title: VOKA ↔ GHARIBO integration boundary behind an AI Gateway
decisions.decision: Integrate VOKA and GHARIBO only across an explicit AI Gateway boundary.
decisions.rationale: An explicit boundary keeps the two systems independently deployable and prevents VOKA's private commercial and transaction data from leaking into GHARIBO's public surface.

decisions.title: GHARIBO Master State as the canonical single source of truth
decisions.decision: Establish governance/GHARIBO_MASTER_STATE.json as the canonical machine-readable project state, with a deterministic generator, a validator and a generated human view.
decisions.rationale: A single validated source of truth stops the document set drifting from the code and makes a material decision official only once it is recorded, validated, documented and checkpointed.

decisions.title: Real model-compatibility qualification before the engine freeze
decisions.decision: Extend the environment qualification contract with a second part that loads openai/gpt-oss-20b on a real free-Kaggle T4, verifies tokenizer and Harmony, initialises QLoRA adapters, collates one batch and runs a forward-only dry run under no_grad, proving by parameter digest that no parameter is updated.
decisions.rationale: The engine freeze (architecture 15 O3) was gated on a dependency-only qualification that never loaded the model, so the central 20B-on-16GB hardware bet would have been frozen unmeasured. Loading weights costs nothing; updating them is what the zero-cost policy and the CEO mandate forbid, and the digest proves the difference.

decisions.title: CTO governance corrections: TRAIN-ONLY fixture, generic GPU, output hygiene, no auto-freeze
decisions.decision: Apply four CTO governance corrections to the M3C qualification harness: (1) attach only train.jsonl as a TRAIN-ONLY fixture with qualification_fixture_source and test_data_accessed fields; (2) replace hardcoded T4 x2 with generic GPU detection recording gpu_count, gpu_models, vram_per_gpu, total_visible_vram, and multi_gpu_used_by_loader; (3) add output hygiene guard checking for forbidden output files; (4) add auto_freeze_applied=false and experiment_authorized=false to enforce CTO inspection before any freeze.
decisions.rationale: The harness must not require access to validation or test data, must not hardcode a specific GPU configuration, must verify output cleanliness, and must not auto-freeze without CTO review. These corrections enforce governance discipline before the Kaggle run.

decisions.title: Accept Kaggle v6 qualification and apply the measured engine freeze
decisions.decision: Accept qualification artifact 6d15bcf5ff7b120f34c7cb968eab196be285ad92b4ad2e76c44412360113dcc0 as the M3C environment/model-compatibility evidence and apply its measured dependency freeze to the GHARIBO training package. torch and triton remain Kaggle environment-preserved runtime facts and triton_kernels remains conditional on the preserved Kaggle path. This decision does NOT authorize GHARIBO-exp-001 and does NOT start training.
decisions.rationale: Two independent fresh dependency-resolution environments were identical, the active Kaggle runtime aligned to the winning set, openai/gpt-oss-20b loaded through the intended 4-bit QLoRA path, the forward-only dry run completed under no_grad, the trainable-parameter digest was unchanged, TEST data was not accessed, output hygiene passed, and no optimizer, backward pass, optimizer step or training loop executed.

decisions.title: Governed physical Gold package preview with explicit candidate recipe
decisions.decision: Extend Training Package schema to 1.1.0 for physical record_format and the real Gold audit-quarantine policy. Lock the B3 pre-authorization candidate recipe and build two byte-identical previews in memory, bound to the actual Git commit, preview source hash, accepted qualification, engine freeze and Gold hashes. TEST is hash-integrity-only and never returned or bundled. No SQLite, issued package, training run, authorization or training is created.
decisions.rationale: The accepted physical Harmony Gold cannot be faithfully represented by Data Factory canonicalization, UI defaults or an invented split minimum. A separate non-executable preview makes preparation reproducible without issuing a real package.

decisions.title: Explicitly authorize GHARIBO-exp-001 for immutable package and run issuance
decisions.decision: Authorize GHARIBO-exp-001 to proceed from PREVIEW_ONLY preparation to immutable Training Package and Training Run issuance using code snapshot ad1e011c55729f5447b324d35b4ad88d0a47d10f, preview identity f11e9c8eeac34888b3ca6679348093cd3a96a46fb95fd42ef3dd36cf8b18709c, recipe hash c2360979bf3de8d91a01ec1c9fe792acc7207ba25a20a94c610fa7084c7fdcdd, accepted qualification 6d15bcf5ff7b120f34c7cb968eab196be285ad92b4ad2e76c44412360113dcc0, engine freeze unsloth-freeze-2026.09.15, and the governed Gold dataset/split identities. This authorization does not itself issue a package or run and does not execute training.
decisions.rationale: The user, acting as CTO and decision authority, explicitly authorized completion of DEC-0025 while prohibiting package/run issuance and execution in this checkpoint. The deterministic preview, recipe, real-Kaggle qualification, measured engine freeze, Gold identity and execution/persistence guards have all been verified. Authorization is therefore granted for issuance only while preserving a separate execution boundary.

decisions.title: Authorize the exact issued GHARIBO-exp-001 run for QUEUED execution preparation
decisions.decision: Authorize only the immutable GHARIBO-exp-001 package 78dd1bf374ed1c53785ea50bf179b1b7a4764d40c121d3d41cda4e2a2e3e68f2 and run ea6e30f2-ce26-4323-b35a-3436ee867eaf to move from sealed DRAFT to QUEUED on the approved Kaggle worker. This checkpoint does not authorize QUEUED to RUNNING, does not launch Kaggle, and does not start training.
decisions.rationale: The CEO explicitly approved the separate Execution Authorization checkpoint after DEC-0025 issuance was completed and independently verified. Maintaining a separate Kaggle-start boundary prevents an authorization action from implicitly beginning GPU training.

decisions.title: Authorize the exact queued GHARIBO-exp-001 run for Kaggle start
decisions.decision: Authorize the exact already-issued and DEC-0026-queued GHARIBO-exp-001 run to be submitted to the private Kaggle worker using the content-addressed safe launch bundle fec22ca290645035fc807f3cc6dec40c5f26389b18f490e932c4bd05e31cb4c0. TRAIN and VALIDATION are the only attached payloads; TEST remains HASH_INTEGRITY_ONLY. This decision authorizes the external start attempt but does not claim that Kaggle accepted, scheduled or started training.
decisions.rationale: The CEO explicitly approved Kaggle Start after the safe launch notebook was structurally verified, the official Kaggle CLI was installed and authenticated, and the exact queued package/run identities remained unchanged.

decisions.title: Repair the governed Kaggle launch artifact and re-authorize a single retry
decisions.decision: The first DEC-0027 launch reached KernelWorkerStatus.ERROR inside the notebook's pinned-engine install cell. The committed worker source is repaired: install observability with a dry-run probe and a redacted diagnostic artifact, the Kaggle-preserve install strategy already proven by the accepted M3C qualification harness, TRAIN+VALIDATION-only dataset verification with an explicit TEST-payload guard and Kaggle input-root discovery, numeric PEP 440 dependency floor comparison, a data-driven TEST-payload policy in the bundle and operator instructions, and a committed reproducible launch-bundle generator. The repaired artifact - notebook sha256 be4af0d4f9a492e7c6b5a2b713b205e17adf7d34d0d0f62aaf1589977cec54ba and launch bundle hash 4380da6382a1484ed41388661057c4a9c1c60f7ae34d612380a4b6f36da21230 - is authorized for exactly one retry on the private Kaggle worker. The governed recipe, base model, dataset, splits, dependency set and TEST policy are unchanged. TRAINING HAS NOT STARTED.
decisions.rationale: The failure was a correctable defect in the committed worker, not an external hard blocker. Fail-closed governance requires the executed artifact to be exactly the authorized artifact, so repairing the notebook necessarily invalidates the DEC-0027 artifact hash and requires a new checkpoint. DEC-0027 keeps every evidence field it recorded and remains the historical record for the artifact it actually anchored; it is superseded for launch purposes only. The DEC-0027 launch bundle hash was produced by an uncommitted ad-hoc step and was not reproducible from the repository, so this checkpoint also supersedes it with a committed, documented algorithm.

decisions.title: Stage the governed Kaggle install and re-authorize a single retry
decisions.decision: The second DEC-0028 launch reached KernelWorkerStatus.ERROR inside the notebook's pinned-engine install cell. The repaired observability surfaced the real cause: Section 4 submitted the entire frozen set to one resolver transaction, and unsloth/unsloth_zoo declare datasets<4.4.0 while the frozen set pins datasets==5.0.1, making the transaction unsatisfiable. Section 4 now reproduces the accepted M3C qualification's staging discipline - a resolver-managed stage for everything the resolver can validate, a --upgrade --no-deps stage for the knowingly over-constrained pair, and a --no-deps torchao support stage. The governed dependency SET is unchanged: every declared dependency is still installed at its declared spec. The repaired artifact - notebook sha256 dda3b050034afa0922bda573565ff8f678767e62a944a01d597761aec254b4b1 and launch bundle hash b3b4efc8f4b4c04eedd8610b6b4cdb479817d638e971ce8e8c9b67079d587efb - is authorized for exactly one retry on the private Kaggle worker. The governed recipe, base model, dataset, splits, dependency set, engine freeze and TEST policy are unchanged. TRAINING HAS NOT STARTED.
decisions.rationale: The failure was a correctable defect in the committed worker's resolution strategy, not an external hard blocker, and not a reason to change any governed dependency version. The accepted qualification never encountered the conflict because it never placed the pair in one resolver transaction; its measured record shows the qualified runtime running datasets==5.0.1 together with unsloth_zoo==2026.9.3 with active_runtime_alignment IDENTICAL. Reproducing that staging therefore restores fidelity to the qualified environment rather than departing from it. Because the notebook bytes changed, fail-closed governance requires the executed artifact to be re-authorized, so DEC-0028 keeps every evidence field it recorded and is superseded for launch purposes only.
